title: Kid from Kadoka
author: Sarah Kaiser
problems: The progression after row 6 "square through four - partners balance & pull by right, then neighbors pull by left, then repeat · pull by" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
